places.quote: round the corner—in Bishopsgate Street Without—one Brogley, sworn broker and appraiser
places.note: Location of Brogley's shop; the scene itself is at Solomon's shop.

places.quote: Captain Cuttle’s lodgings—at once a first floor and a top storey, in Brig Place—were close before you.
places.note: Fictional-sounding but lodgings are near the India Docks; locate approximately.

places.normalized: West India Docks, Isle of Dogs, London
places.quote: Captain Cuttle lived on the brink of a little canal near the India Docks
places.note: Docks rather than a building; Dickens's 'India Docks' may refer to the East or West India Docks.

places.quote: a gulf had opened in the City, which had swallowed up his old friend
places.note: Used figuratively as a place name for the financial district.

places.quote: sits upon the ruins of other people’s Carthages
